name: SHA-512 Hash
summary: Compute a SHA-512 digest of any text in your browser — copy lowercase or uppercase hex.
description: Hash UTF-8 text with SHA-512 (FIPS 180-4) entirely client-side. Toggle uppercase hex and copy the 128-character digest. No data leaves your device.

faqs.question: Is SHA-512 stronger than SHA-256?
faqs.answer: SHA-512 produces a 512-bit digest and is in the same SHA-2 family. Choose based on protocol requirements; both are widely considered secure for integrity hashing.

faqs.question: Is my text uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Hashing runs entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: What encoding is used?
faqs.answer: Input is hashed as UTF-8 bytes.
